what: A 3D sphere (camera fov 45 · z 7) of 200 photo plates bent onto a radius-5 sphere surface is always turning at .1rad/s — on attach it turns 280° in over 4.7s power3.out while the plates light up from .72 → 1 in azimuth order and the fog (near .5→4, far 3→14) clears over 3.2s. When scrolling is fast, that speed is added to the rotation over .2s, then released over 1.9s after .35s, and while it spins fast the plates bend as if their leading edges were being dragged

options.speed: Constant spin speed (rad/s), default .1 — rgf About header .072
options.cam: Camera distance, default 7 (right in front of the sphere) — about 13.5 to see it whole
options.entry: If off, it stands in place without entering
options.kick: When off, scroll speed adds no rotation
options.[data-fx-part=photo]: (optional) photo img to attach to the panel — up to 32 into atlas cells. If none, color patches drawn from the skin colors (accent·text·background)
options.bend: Bend strength (original velocityDeformationDistance), default -0.6 — at 0 it doesn’t bend

note: window.THREE must exist — load pixel-trail-panel/three-global.js before three.cjs of _vendor/three@0.179.0. The panel is not drawn when it is off screen. The original’s curvature transition (at 12% scroll, the flat plane the camera was viewing attaches to the sphere surface over 1.1s) is not there yet — the panel sits on the sphere from the start

from.where: sphere.js·index.js home hero photo sphere — original settings radius 5 · fov 45 · z7 · 200 photos · .1rad/s · entry 280° 4.7s power3.out · fog 3.2s · scroll acceleration decelerates over 1.9s (the About hero is z13.5 · .072rad/s · no entry)
